result.notes: Reviewed all 250 entries (2906–3155). Stress notation uses ASCII apostrophes, so a leading apostrophe alone is not flagged. Two entries have no phonetic value: 2914 and 2950. Besides those two, the main defects are duplicate primary-stress marks in number words and in a few longer words. Noun/verb stress heteronyms such as survey (3039), abstract (3136), and abuse (3139) already have meanings or examples that pick the right reading, so they are not counted as errors; however, 3039 embeds an editorial note '(for v.)' inside the IPA field and should be moved to a separate field. Non-pronunciation data issues to fix separately: 3126 wild has JSON markup in its example; 2989 hurt contains an invisible zero-width character inside the IPA; 3066 garage uses a colon length mark that is inconsistent with the rest of the file. American/British pairs (mom/mum type, yoghurt/yogurt, maths, clerk, garage) were not flagged.
